description: Decompose one reference image into an exploded "parts board" image (async) — the subject laid out as separated components on one canvas. Input: `asset_id` (an existing IMAGE asset you own), `image_url` (a public http/https image), OR `image_path` (a local file, uploaded directly). Engine/resolution/prompt are server-fixed — no params. Returns an asset { id }; call wait_for_asset (or poll get_asset) until taskStatus=2 and read files.image (the board PNG). Feed that image to generate_3d_from_image for a parts-separated mesh. Costs 80 credits — see list_models(category='parts-board'). Precedence when several are set: image_path > asset_id > image_url.

asset_id.description: id of an existing IMAGE asset you own to decompose

image_path.description: absolute path to a local image file (≤20MB), uploaded directly

name: parts_board
